newsitem.title: UK: UK's William Baird says good start in 1997.
newsitem.headline: UK's William Baird says good start in 1997.

text.p: British clothing designer and manufacturer William Baird Plc, which supplies clothing to retail businesses including Marks and Spencer plc said on Tuesday that it had made a good start to the current year.

"William Baird has seen a good start to the year. Strong performances have been achieved in both the Marks & Spencer and Brand divisions," the group's chairman Donald Parr told an annual meeting of shareholders.
He said if there was no downturn in consumer spending, the board remained confident of "further good progress" in 1997.
The company said its disposal programme was on track and its strong operating cash flow performance seen in the second half of 1996 had continued into 1997.
